_comment: The walk map plus Hips. Only death uses this one.
_whyHips: A collapse is mostly the hips pitching over; the limbs alone leave a corpse standing. Every other clip drops Hips because its rotation carries the captured body's facing and entity.yaw decides that — but a dead body has no facing to protect, so here the capture wins.
_whyNotRoot: The fall to the floor is in the captured root, which the engine does not apply. project/plugins/damage.js already sinks entity.y to corpse height, which covers it.
